title: CUTN Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN) has announced the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in M.E/ M.Tech. or M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the CUTN Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
